added_comments.text: Precedence (lowest to highest): defaults < config file < APP_* env vars

rationale: The agent removed the _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround entirely and fixed mergeLayers so env vars take precedence over the file for all keys, resolving the root cause rather than adding a special case for APP_CACHE__TTL_SECONDS. It preserved the SOC2 log-level exception (profile === "production" deletion of envLayer.logLevel is untouched and covered by a new test) while removing the old workaround comment.
